data.name: Evania
data.gender_notes: Evania is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Evania was the goddess of fertility and the protector of women in childbirth. Her name is derived from the Greek word 'evos' meaning 'yield' or 'productive'. The name Evania carries the meaning “Goddess of Fertility” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Evania usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of fertility and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes new beginnings, growth, and nurturing.
data.etymology: Evania belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Fertility.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Evania total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_hebrew.name: אבניה
in_hebrew.meaning: אבניה היא שם שפירושו אבן אלוהים או אלוהים הוא אבני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אבניה היא שם עברי שמקורו במילים 'אבן' ו'אלוהים'. הוא מתייחס לאבן או סלע שמהווה בסיס או תמיכה. השם אבניה מופיע בתנ"ך כהתייחסות לאבן או אבן שעליה נשען האל. לאבן זו יש חשיבות רבה ביהדות כסמל לאמונה וכמיסד לעם היהודי. השם אבניה משמש גם כזכר לאבן הפינה או אבן היסוד שבהקמת מקדשים ומבנים רבים בתקופת המקרא.

in_greek.name: Εβανία
in_greek.meaning: Εβανία σημαίνει Θεός εἰς ἐμὲ ἢ εὐσέβεια τοῦ Θεοῦ
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Εβανία προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν εὐχαριστία καὶ τὴν εὐσέβειαν πρὸς τὸν Θεό. Ἡ λέξη συνδέεται μὲ τὴν ἑβραϊκὴ λέξη 'אבניה', ἡ ὁποία σημαίνει 'Θεός εἰς ἐμὲ' ἢ 'ἡ πέτρα τοῦ Θεοῦ'. Στὴν Καινή Διαθήκη, παρόμοια ονόματα συνδέονται μὲ τὴν πίστη καὶ τὴν ἀγάπη πρὸς τὸν Θεό. Ἡ Εβανία συμβολίζει τὴν πνευματική σχέση μὲ τὸ Θεό καὶ τὴν προσήλωσή της σ'Αὐτό.

in_latin.name: Evania
in_latin.meaning: Evania significat Deus est in me vel pietas Dei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Evania originem habet in voce hebraica 'אבניה', quae interpretatur 'Deus est in me' vel 'petra Dei'. Hoc nomen in traditione christiana significat pietatem et devotionem erga Deum. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomina quae cum pietate et fide coniuncta erant, magna cum diligentia eligeabantur. Evania itaque personam designat quae cum Deo intima familiaritate coniuncta est.

in_english.name: Evania
in_english.meaning: Evania means God is in me or God's pebble
in_english.long_meaning: The name Evania originates from the Hebrew 'אבניה' (Avaniah), meaning 'God is in me' or 'God's stone/rock'. It symbolizes a strong spiritual connection with God and is associated with faith and devotion. Historically, names derived from Hebrew roots were significant in Christian tradition, reflecting one's relationship with God. Evania represents a person with deep faith and spiritual strength.

It is a reminder of the importance of fertility and the cycles of life and rebirth.

Evania can also be seen as a representation of the nurturing and life-giving nature of God, who brings new life and renewal to all things.
